problem: <str> Short identifier for the optimization problem.
description: <str> Brief natural-language summary of the problem setting.

dimensions.num_items: <int> Total number of distinct items to be produced.
dimensions.num_periods: <int> Number of discrete time periods in the planning horizon.

plant_capabilities: <list[list[int]], length num_items> For each item, the list of plant indices capable of producing that item.
customer_item_demands: <list[list[int]], length num_customers> For each customer, the list of item indices ordered by that customer.
demand: <list[list[list[int]]], shape [num_items][num_customers][num_periods]> Quantity of each item demanded by each customer in each period.
setup_cost: <list[list[list[int]]], shape [num_items][num_plants][num_periods]> Fixed cost incurred when initiating a production lot for an item at a plant in a period.
production_cost: <list[list[list[int]]], shape [num_items][num_plants][num_periods]> Per-unit cost of producing an item at a plant in a period.
holding_cost: <list[list[list[int]]], shape [num_items][num_plants][num_periods]> Per-unit per-period cost of holding inventory of an item at a plant in a period.
setup_time: <list[list[list[int]]], shape [num_items][num_plants][num_periods]> Time consumed to set up production of an item at a plant in a period.
production_time: <list[list[list[int]]], shape [num_items][num_plants][num_periods]> Per-unit time consumed to produce an item at a plant in a period.
capacity: <list[list[int]], shape [num_plants][num_periods]> Available production time at each plant in each period.
plant_opening_cost: <list[int], length num_plants> Total cost over the entire horizon to open each plant.
plant_opening_cost_per_period: <list[list[int]], shape [num_plants][num_periods]> Portion of each plant's opening cost attributed to each period.
transportation_cost: <list[list[list[list[int]]]], shape [num_items][num_customers][num_plants][num_periods]> Per-unit cost of shipping an item from a plant to a customer in a period.
